item.title: 5 Trending Nollywood Movies to Add to Your YouTube Watchlist This Week
item.description: Official poster for The River Remembers starring Teniola Aladese and Taye Arimoro, streaming on Omoni Oboli TV. Secrets have a way of coming out, family ties can get complicated, and love doesn’t always go according to plan. These are just some of the stories unfolding in this week’s Nollywood releases on YouTube. From psychological drama and riverine mysteries to corporate battles and family betrayals, here are five films bringing different stories to the screen. 7 Years Silence (Bolaji Ogunmola TV) What happens when a web of long-kept secrets finally unravels after nearly a decade? 7 Years Silence follows a devoted wife who, after seven years of marriage and a painful struggle to conceive, discovers her seemingly perfect husband has been living a complete double life. As hidden motives and suppressed truths explode into the open, every character is forced to face the shattering fallout of a marriage built on an illusion. This gripping emotional thriller features standout performances by BamBam ( Bamike Olawunmi – Adenibuyan ), Deyemi Okanlawon , and Teniola Aladese . The River Remembers (Omoni Oboli TV) Love and dark ancestral secrets collide in this haunting riverine drama. Newly engaged Morayo and Akindele travel to his hometown to celebrate their future, but beside a forbidden river, Morayo’s recurring nightmares begin to unearth a devastating truth. As painful revelations draw an unyielding line between their families, the couple is forced to choose between their dream together or losing each other to a past they never chose. Produced by Nollywood powerhouse Omoni Oboli, the movie stars Taye Arimoro , Teniola Aladese , Kunle Omisore , Najite Dede , Olami Samuel , Bridget John , Oyetola Elemosho , Tolu Otebiyi , Paul Word , Taiwo Familoni . Caught in the Cycle (Biodun Stephen TV) Tackling heavy themes of trauma, broken trust, and survival, Caught in the Cycle delivers an intense psychological ride. The narrative centers on a gifted teenage girl whose life takes a terrifying turn after she is taken in by a wealthy couple promising her a brighter future. Instead of sanctuary, she finds herself trapped in a living nightmare of abuse, manipulation, and betrayal—ultimately leading to a shocking crime that forces her to fight with everything she has for her freedom and the truth. Directed by Olubunmi Akingbola and produced by Biodun Stephen , the film relies on raw, high-stakes performances from an impressive cast starring Stan Nze , Angel Unigwe , and Leolidas Ewane . User Friendly (RuthKadiri247) High-stakes corporate greed meets unexpected romance in User Friendly. Following her father’s death, billionaire heiress Tenny ( Ruth Kadiri ) struggles to take charge of his business empire as alcohol abuse and poor choices make her a prime target for manipulative relatives. item.title: The killer mistake Cardinals must avoid at 2026 NFL trade deadline
item.description: Image Credit: Kevin Jairaj-Imagn Images The killer mistake Cardinals must avoid at 2026 NFL trade deadline appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Arizona Cardinals can justify selling at the trade deadline. They cannot justify confusing a roster reset with removing the player who should anchor their next competitive team. Trading Trey McBride would cross that line. The Cardinals have already rejected an inquiry from the Denver Broncos, reportedly making clear they have “zero intention” of moving their star tight end. That is the correct position, and general manager Monti Ossenfort must maintain it through Tuesday’s deadline. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The Broncos spoke with the Cardinals about potentially trading for TE Trey McBride, per ESPN. The Cardinals made it clear they are not trading the Colorado native and the Broncos moved on. Denver has been making calls about potentially trading for a tight end. pic.twitter.com/JTpsmzqXZs — Zac Stevens (@ZacStevens) November 7, 2026 Arizona’s struggles might invite aggressive offers, but McBride is not a veteran whose usefulness expires before the franchise can recover. He is a 26-year-old offensive centerpiece under contract through 2029. Moving him would create another major problem rather than solve the existing ones. Trey McBride is the foundation, not expendable inventory Joe Rondone/The Republic / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images McBride’s production separates him from the typical deadline trade candidate. He finished 2025 with 126 receptions, 1,239 receiving yards and 11 touchdowns, setting the NFL single-season record for catches by a tight end and earning first-team All-Pro recognition. He has remained productive despite Arizona’s instability this season. Through nine games, McBride has 73 catches for 598 yards and five touchdowns. Even during Sunday’s 17-3 loss at Seattle, he caught seven of eight targets for 54 yards. Those numbers do not mean the offense is functioning properly. They mean Arizona already possesses one dependable component while searching for answers elsewhere. The mistake would be treating that reliability as merely an opportunity to collect draft picks. Draft capital matters because it helps teams find difference-makers. McBride already qualifies as one. His presence gives the Cardinals an established receiving option around whom they can construct their next offensive plan. Removing him would force the organization to spend additional resources replacing production it already controls. Arizona’s quarterback transition makes keeping him essential The Cardinals have already changed their offensive personnel significantly, trading Marvin Harrison Jr. and Jacoby Brissett before turning to Gardner Minshew at quarterback. That makes McBride more important, not less. Any quarterback evaluation requires a reasonably functional supporting cast. Strip away the most dependable target, and distinguishing quar

item.title: Smriti Mandhana to lead India across all three formats on South Africa tour
item.description: India have announced their squads for the upcoming all-format tour of South Africa in December, with Smriti Mandhana named captain for the Test, ODI and T20I teams. The tour will feature one Test, three ODIs and three T20Is, beginning with the Test in Gqeberha on December 9. Deepti Sharma has been appointed vice-captain for the Test and ODI teams, while Shafali Verma will take up the role in T20Is. The Test and ODI squads have 15 players each, while the T20I squad features 17 members. Vaishnavi Sharma replaces Sneh Rana in the ODI squad, while several young players, including Niki Prasad, G. Kamalini and Anushka Sharma, have earned places in the T20I team. Full tour schedule India's tour will begin with a Test match in Gqeberha on December 9. The three-match ODI series will be played in Paarl, Cape Town and Bloemfontein on December 16, 19 and 22, respectively. The T20I series will begin in Benoni on December 26, followed by matches in Potchefstroom on December 29 and 30. India’s Test Squad: Smriti Mandhana [C], Shafali Verma, Pratika Rawal, Harmanpreet Kaur, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harleen Deol, Richa Ghosh [WK], Yastika Bhatia [WK], Deepti Sharma [VC], Sree Charani, Sneh Rana, Kranti Gaud, Nandni Sharma, Jintimani Kalita, Sayali Satghare India’s ODI Squad: Smriti Mandhana [C], Shafali Verma, Pratika Rawal, Harmanpreet Kaur, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harleen Deol, Richa Ghosh [WK], Yastika Bhatia [WK], Deepti Sharma [VC], Sree Charani, Vaishnavi Sharma, Kranti Gaud, Nandni Sharma, Jintimani Kalita, Sayali Satghare India’s T20I Squad: Smriti Mandhana [C], Shafali Verma [VC], Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur, Niki Prasad, Richa Ghosh [WK], G. Kamalini [WK], Anushka Sharma, Deepti Sharma, Sree Charani, Prema Rawat, Amanjot Kaur, Kranti Gaud, Nandni Sharma, Renuka Singh Thakur, Arundhati Reddy, Sayali Satghare. 135686066

item.title: Javier Hernández defends Michael Carrick, calls on Man Utd players to ‘give your life for this club’
item.description: Javier Hernández won two Premier League titles with Manchester United -Credit:James Gill - Danehouse/Getty Images Former Mexico international and longtime Manchester United striker Javier Hernández launched into an impassioned defense of former teammate and current Red Devils boss Michael Carrick on Sunday. Prior to their dramatic 4-4 home draw against Aston Villa, which saw Carrick’s side come back from two goals down twice to secure a valuable point ahead of the international break, Hernández gave his view on the United boss and who he believes is to blame for their abysmal season to date. Speaking to Sky Sports , the 38-year-old said of Carrick, “I am confident. I am a believer that if sometimes the decisions cannot be in your own way, and I'm not saying because I'm completely in favor; I'm saying in the world, I'm more in favour of like, if a decision is taken already, instead of staying complaining, go with it, and let's see if it was right or not, because then time is going to say. Soccer star Jesús de Miguel tragically dies aged 30 after mid-game collision as tributes paid Alisson opens up on Liverpool future as goalkeeper's Anfield contract winds down Michael Carrick's side is 18th in the Premier League -Credit:Catherine Ivill - AMA/Getty Images “Last season, he did an amazing job. He brought United back to the Champions League. So yeah, now the start of the season wasn't like we expected. We are used to normally when you have a very good season, to maintain that, obviously, but football is like that.” Hernández, who won two Premier League titles with United, went on to add, “I think Michael is the correct man. Yes, his personality helps a lot because he has a lot of composure. He's a very calm guy, that he can manage all the pressure and all of this over there. And I think he's the correct man.” The Atlético Dallas forward went on to explain that even during the days of Sir Alex Ferguson, when times were tough, the onus was on the players to perform, and less on what tactics the legendary Scot was attempting to implement. And it’s clear that Hernández believes this is equally applicable today, believing there is only so much Carrick can do once the whistle blows. “After this white line, when the whistle blows, there's nothing much more than the manager can do,” he said. “They can tell you defend more, run more, or whatever. But putting that shirt, putting this Manchester United shirt, you shouldn't be looking what is lacking. “You need to give your life for this club because it can be one of your best or the best chapter in your career for a lot of us, for example, and for a lot of players. So you have to give everything. item.title: Public Notice To Gaming Operators And The General Public.
item.description: FEDERAL CAPITAL TERRITORY LOTTERY REGULATORY OFFICE (FCT-LRO) O ﬃ ce of the Director-General PUBLIC NOTICE TO GAMING OPERATORS AND THE GENERAL PUBLIC. FCT-LRO COMMENCES FULL BUSINESS OPERATIONS The Federal Capital Territory Lottery Regulatory Oﬃce (FCT-LRO) hereby informs gaming operators, industry stakeholders and the general public that the Oﬃce has commenced operations as the regulatory authority responsible for the oversight, regulation and supervision of gaming activities within the Federal Capital Territory (FCT). 1. REGULATORY JURISDICTION Following the Supreme Court judgment in Attorney-General of Lagos State & 21 Others v. Attorney-General of the Federation & 15 Others, Suit No. SC/1/2008, the constitutional position on the regulation of lotteries and gaming has been clarified. By virtue of Section 299 of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 (as amended), the FCT has a distinct constitutional status, with the National Assembly exercising legislative powers ordinarily vested in a State House of Assembly. Accordingly, gaming operators conducting business within the FCT are required to comply with the applicable FCT licensing and regulatory requirements and engage with the FCT- LRO on all regulatory matters. 2. ONLINE GAMING OPERATIONS The Oﬃce clarifies that the Supreme Court judgment did not expressly settle the full regulatory framework applicable to online gaming. In particular, the judgment did not establish that any one State has exclusive regulatory control over the online gaming market. Accordingly, the online gaming market remains open to operators and investors. Operators are free to choose the regulator from whom they wish to obtain their gaming licence or authorisation, based on their business model, operational needs and the regulatory framework they consider most suitable and beneficial to their business. This choice may be exercised without undue interference, intimidation or coercive treatment by any State regulator solely on the basis that an operator has elected to obtain its licence from another regulator, as every state is duly empowered to regulate gaming activities within its relevant jurisdiction. Operators are, however, reminded that the online nature of a gaming platform does not, in itself, exempt an operation from applicable licensing and regulatory obligations where such obligations arise. The FCT-LRO remains committed to providing a transparent, consistent and predictable regulatory environment for digital gaming operations within the Federal Capital Territory. 3. NOTICE TO FORMER NLRC LICENSEES All gaming operators previously licensed by the National Lottery Regulatory Commission (NLRC) who are currently operating, or intend to operate, within the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) are hereby required to approach the FCT-LRO to regularise their regulatory status. item.title: Joe Burrow surges past Josh Allen in MVP odds after Madrid masterpiece
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Joe Burrow surges past Josh Allen in MVP odds after Madrid masterpiece appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Over the weekend, Joe Burrow gave an MVP performance in Madrid, Spain. He completed 24 of 29 passes and threw two touchdowns, leading the Bengals to a 34-17 win over the Atlanta Falcons. The performance made Burrow want to play more international games as well as enhance Burrow’s MVP credibility . In the process, Burrow’s chances of winning MVP rose above Buffalo Bills QB Josh Allen , per BetOnline. He rose to +200 points behind Allen, and the Bills prepare to face the Minnesota Vikings on Monday Night. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Burrow currently has a 74% completion rate, 2,386 passing yards, and 23 touchdowns. Meanwhile, the Bengals are tied with the Pittsburgh Steelers for first place in the AFC North at 6-2. The Bengals are also on a four-game winning streak. In the process, Burrow became the first player in NFL history to finish four straight games with four touchdown passes and a 70% pass completion rate. Allen has a 76.3% completion rate, 1,793 passing yards, and 11 touchdowns, and the Bills are 6-1 and in first place in the AFC North. Going into this season, Allen was the favorite to win MVP. Patrick Mahomes, Brock Purdy, Justin Herbert, and C.J. Stroud were also among the preseason favorites. Throughout his career, Burrow was also a top MVP contender but never won. He finished 4th in the voting process in 2022 and 2024. In 2024, Burrow led the league with 4,918 passing yards and 43 touchdowns. However, the Bengals missed the postseason, finishing 9-8. If he keeps it up and the Bengals remain strong, he could achieve the ultimate prize, beyond winning the Super Bowl. The Bengals will play the Steelers on Sunday, November 15, at 7:20pm CST/8:20pm EST at Paycor Stadium in Cincinnati. item.title: Why Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye after three interceptions vs. Packers
item.description: Why Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye after three interceptions vs. Packers originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The New England Patriots lost to the Green Bay Packers in a brutal Week 9 blowout loss. While the struggles of Christian Gonzalez were alarming, one of the more worrying things from this game was Drake Maye's performance. After seemingly getting back on track following a rough start to the season, Maye has regressed again, throwing three more interceptions against the Packers during Sunday's loss. ESPN's Mike Reiss believes that it's time to be worried about Maye, as his interception problem should have the Patriots and their fans concerned. Patriots should be concerned about Drake Maye's INT problem "The Patriots haven't had a positive turnover differential in a game this season and are now minus-11 on the year," Reiss writes. "So there is a high level of concern, especially for a team hoping to make a deep playoff run." Maye threw three interceptions against the Packers in Week 9, and now has 11 total picks on the season. He has already surpassed his eight-interception total from a year ago. He's clearly struggling more than normal, and that's even though his 2,282 passing yards are sixth in the NFL, his 18 passing touchdowns are tied for fourth, and his 73.7 QBR is fifth-best in the league. But his turnover problem is really hurting the Patriots' odds to win these games where his turnover problems really come into play. MORE : Mike Vrabel gives blunt assessment of Christian Gonzalez's struggles The Patriots are 5-4 on the season, and if Maye can't figure things out, they might be in real jeopardy of falling out of a playoff position. While New England might still make the playoffs, the inconsistency of Maye with these interceptions makes it hard to believe in this team come the playoffs. Seeing Maye fix this interception problem might be the difference in this team being able to go on a deep playoff run or not. After another brutal performance, throwing three interceptions in one game, it's hard to believe in Maye right now. Patriots fans and the team should be concerned about Maye, as his turnover struggles are really hurting the team right now and could become a major problem if they don't go away soon. item.title: ⌚ Galo race against time to get players fit for Copa Sul-Americana final
item.description: ⌚ Galo race against time to get players fit for Copa Sul-Americana final Atlético-MG have just five games left in 2026 and need to get several injured players fit again quickly. The main goal is to be at full strength for the CONMEBOL Sudamericana final against Boca Juniors on November 21 in Barranquilla, Colombia. In the 1–1 draw with Grêmio in the Copa do Brasil, Fred and Cassierra came on in the second half but were still short of full fitness. Coach Eduardo Domínguez confirmed that Fred played “through the pain,” as his left thigh injury had not yet healed. Cassierra is also coming back from a thigh injury and played fewer than 30 minutes. Ruan Tressoldi and Maycon, who had already been cleared to play, remained on the bench against Grêmio. Atlético still have three players receiving treatment: Victor Hugo, with a right thigh adductor problem, Reinier, with a left thigh injury, and Thiago Borbas, with a right thigh injury. Borbas is the closest to returning to training with the squad. Lyanco also missed the game against Grêmio. In addition to discomfort in a tendon in his left foot, he was rested due to serious personal issues. Galo are now preparing to face Mirassol on the 14th, followed by the final against Boca. They also have games against Corinthians, Vasco and Bahia remaining in the Brasileirão. This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence. You can read the original version in 🇧🇷 here.

item.title: Dan Orlovsky urges Rams to trade for WR after Puka Nacua’s concerning injury
item.description: Amber Searls-Imagn Images Dan Orlovsky urges Rams to trade for WR after Puka Nacua’s concerning injury appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Los Angeles Rams finally crossed the .500 mark on the 2026 season over the weekend, defeating the Washington Commanders in narrow fashion on the road. While Myles Garrett returned to the lineup in this one and put up a monster performance, wide receiver Puka Nacua went down with a concerning knee injury. The team thankfully doesn’t believe that it is a torn ACL for Nacua, but recently, former NFL quarterback and current ESPN talking head Dan Orlovsky still put the pressure on the Rams’ front office to make a move in response to the injury during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show . “The Los Angeles Rams need to trade for a wide receiver.. Whether Puka Nacua is healthy or not they should be active in the trade market,” said Orlovsky, per Pat McAfee on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Orlovsky isn’t the only pundit to express the sentiment, as the Rams aren’t exactly rife with options at the wide receiver position with both Nacua and Davante Adams dealing with injuries. Quarterback Matthew Stafford has started to turn things around a bit in recent weeks, but he’s still been a far cry from his MVP performance from a season ago, and having another weapon in the wide receiver room would certainly help out the veteran amid his turbulent season. Meanwhile, the Rams’ defense is starting to round into form, especially now that Garrett is back in the fold, as the superstar recorded three sacks during Sunday’s game against the Commanders. In any case, the Rams will next hit the field next Sunday for a divisional road game against the Arizona Cardinals. Kickoff is set for 4:05 pm ET. item.title: Brewers radio host Dominic Cotroneo leaving WTMJ
item.description: Dominic Cotroneo, who's been a fixture on Milwaukee Brewers pregame and postgame coverage since midway through the 2022 season, announced on X that he was leaving WTMJ radio, noting that the maneuver was "100% my decision" and that he doesn't have a fixed plan for what comes next. "I wish them nothing but the best; they gave me an opportunity in the 2022 season to be the new postgame radio host, and that's not an honor I take lightly," Cotroneo said Monday, Nov. 9. "I did the best that I could, and I think WTMJ appreciated my efforts. Sometimes it's OK to say goodbye." Cotroneo, 32, has a number of irons in the fire. He frequently offers Brewers coverage on his YouTube channel and has been working independently on the Service Time podcast, a deep dive into the history of labor in Major League Baseball – a timely topic given the swirling winds around an MLB lockout likely beginning Dec. 1. With so much unknown for next season for myself and the industry, I wanted to build on a YouTube base that grew quickly during the postseason. I can create baseball content on my own volition and prepare for spring training (whenever that is) — Dominic Cotroneo (@Dom_Cotroneo) November 9, 2026 Cotroneo's coverage with WTMJ included "Brewers Extra Innings," the station's postgame call-in show, and later included "Brewers Warmup" before network pregame coverage, the "Brewers Weekly" program on Thursday nights and written coverage on the radio station's website. WTMJ has been the flagship station for Brewers game broadcasts for almost the entirety of the franchise's time in Milwaukee. He has also operated as the "talent stats" guru for Brewers.TV broadcasts and filled a similar role for TBS, often doing in-game research to supplement broadcasts. Cotroneo makes no bones about his desire to move into an MLB play-by-play role. His previous experience as a minor-league announcer included stops in Orem, Utah; Kinston, North Carolina; and Corpus Christi, Texas. His father, Vince, called MLB games for 32 years, with tenures working for the Houston Astros, Texas Rangers and Oakland Athletics. Vince cut his teeth in a similar role to the one Dominic holds now, working alongside legendary broadcaster Milo Hamilton. "I don't know what the future holds for any of this, between the lockout, play-by-play jobs … it gets to a point where you need to take a leap of faith," Dominic said. "It doesn't mean I'm going to leave Milwaukee or leave this market." This article originally appeared on Milwaukee Journal Sentinel: Brewers radio host Dominic Cotroneo leaving WTMJ

item.title: Lakers bench's reaction to Duncan Robinson says everything about Pistons sharpshooter's signature skill
item.description: Lakers bench's reaction to Duncan Robinson says everything about Pistons sharpshooter's signature skill originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Duncan Robinson is no NBA superstar. But his gifts — from his connectivity as a playmaker to his glittering basketball IQ — have made him a useful player to the Pistons in recent years. Robinson's calling card through seven years in the league is his shooting. He's less a man than a trebuchet beyond the arc, known to rise above late closeouts to inflict damage upon opposition defenses. He has done that in droves in 2026-27, producing career-best figures for 6-3 Detroit. In the Pistons' loss to the 121-116 loss to the Lakers on Sunday, Robinson's penchant for triples — and the attention it received on Los Angeles' scouting report — became immediately evident to those watching on. Here's what you need to know. DAZN Lakers bench's reaction to Duncan Robinson says everything about Pistons sharpshooter's signature skill Robinson found a bit of daylight towards the end of Sunday's game, shedding Walker Kessler before fielding a pass from Kevin Huerter and firing from beyond the arc. Predictably, the triple nestled calmly into the net. Robinson was largely ineffective from distance on Sunday, only finding his mark on three of 11 attempts. Nevertheless, Los Angeles bench's animated reaction to the miscue — spearheaded by a leaping Jake LaRavia, a frustrated Jarred Vanderbilt and the typically-stoic Sandro Mamukelashvili sinking into his seat after the ball whistled through the hoop — indicated that JJ Redick's side was, indeed, worried about Robinson's shooting prowess. Watch the Lakers bench when Kessler leaves Robinson to help... https://t.co/vUMv3QL0ZM — Coach Gibson Pyper (@HalfCourtHoops) November 9, 2026 It's easy to see why. Robinson is averaging a career-best 18.2 points per game this season, starring in an increased role in J.B. Bickerstaff's setup. He ranks fifth in the league in three-pointers made (38) and is shooting a career-high from deep 45.2 percent. Los Angeles' response might have seemed a bit exaggerated given Robinson's relative standing around the league. But make no mistakes about it; Robinson deserves the attention. His shooting gifts glisten under the spotlight. LaRavia, Vanderbilt and Mamukelashvili understood as much. WATCH: Watch Pistons games and more on DAZN

item.title: Which Bengals have won NFL MVP award? Is Joe Burrow next?
item.description: Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow is considered by many to be the frontrunner for this season's AP NFL Most Valuable Player award, which would be his first. Burrow is on pace for more than 5,000 passing yards and 55 passing touchdowns. Burrow had a career-best 4,918 passing yards with 43 passing TDs in 2024. Only two Bengals have won the award: QB Boomer Esiason in 1988, and QB Ken Anderson in 1981. During analysis on NFL Network ahead of the Bengals' NFL Week 9 win against Atlanta in Madrid, Pro Football Hall of Famer Kurt Warner said he thinks Burrow, Warner's NFL MVP pick, can lead the team back to the Super Bowl. Joe Burrow would be the third Bengals QB to win AP NFL MVP award. Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen had been considered the frontrunner for the award before Burrow's impressive recent run of 16 passing TDs over the past four games. Burrow was one of five finalists for the 2024 award, which Allen won . Burrow finished the 2024 season as the league leader in passing yards and touchdown passes . Burrow added a rushing TD against Atlanta, and reacted with a unique celebration . Before the game, Burrow greeted Spanish soccer star Ferran Torres. After the game, Burrow said Ja'Marr Chase "was unbelievable" against Atlanta, swapped jerseys with Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, and told reporters he'd love to play in the first NFL game in Tokyo. This article originally appeared on Cincinnati Enquirer: Which Bengals have won NFL MVP award? Is Joe Burrow next?

item.title: Lexi Thompson believes WTGL will help grow the game of golf
item.description: LPGA golfers pose for a photo during WTGL Media Day at SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida on September 20, 2026. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co The future is here. WTGL kicked off on Sunday, Los Angeles Golf Club defeated New York , and it is already back in action. Tuesday will see L.A. take on Motor City Golf Club, Lexi Thompson’s team. Women’s golf has grown so much over the last 20 years and that time span just about directly coincides with Lexi’s professional career. Everyone remembers her making her U.S. Open debut in 2007 at the age of 12, and in the time since she has piled up the wins, titles, and now has a spot in the startup league… while pregnant to boot. Lexi was kind enough to take some time to join me for a conversation about WTGL on Monday. You can watch it in its entirety below. As noted I find Lexi to be such an important figure in the world of golf at large. She has been such a trailblazer in the game, and she continues to be with WTGL in general, but that she is taking it on while carrying a child is an entirely different level of impressiveness. Lexi and her fellow WTGL players have all talked about what an opportunity the league represents for them and the next generation. In Lexi’s case she is quite literally carrying that generation to and through her WTGL experience. This year may mark the first literal season of WTGL, but it has been in the works for a long time if you really think about it. What the Lexi Thompsons of the world have done, many of whom share the WTGL experience with her, over the course of their careers has helped to open the door of possibility for all involved. Here’s to seeing what they and those they continue to inspire can do next. Tuesday’s match between Motor City Golf Club and Los Angeles Golf Club can be seen on Ion at 7pm CT.

item.title: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report
item.description: Barcelona make enquiry for Bayern Munich defender ahead of January window – report In a major development, Florian Plettenberg of Sky Germany reports that Barcelona have made an enquiry for Bayern Munich defensive mainstay Jonathan Tah. The Blaugrana are scouring the market for an experienced defender to partner Pau Cubarsi at the heart of the defence and see the German international as an appealing target. Tah back on Barcelona’s radar Tah is a name very familiar to Barcelona, considering that they had shown a strong interest in signing him back in 2025, when his contract at Bayer Leverkusen was expiring. The La Liga champions explored the possibility of a move but decided not to sign him, and he ended up moving to Bayern Munich. Since joining the Bundesliga title holders, the 30-year-old has grown into a mainstay at the back, racking up 67 appearances in which he has three goals and assists each. Back on Barcelona’s radar. (Photo by Alexander Hassenstein/Getty Images) As per the report, Barcelona director Deco and manager Hansi Flick continue to rate Tah highly, and therefore, an enquiry has now been made regarding his availability. January move not an option However, the journalist states that, as things stand, a January move for Tah is not seen as viable for Barcelona. The German international is settled well at Bayern Munich, who themselves have no intentions of letting the centre-back leave the club in January. As such, Barça’s interest is unlikely to proceed beyond the enquiry that has been made for the 30-year-old defender, whose contract at the Allianz Arena runs until the summer of 2029. Bayern will not sell Tah in January. (Photo by Lars Baron/Getty Images) While Tah may be well-liked by the club, previous reports have strongly suggested that the preference for Flick & co. is to sign a left-footed centre-back. Lisandro Martinez of Manchester United, whose contract expires in 2027, has emerged as the most realistic target for Barcelona . Meanwhile, there have also been tentative links to players like Real Betis’ Natan and Piero Hincapie of Arsenal. It remains to be seen who Barcelona go after to strengthen their backline during the upcoming January window. What seems certain is that a move for Tah is unlikely to pan out for the Catalans.

item.title: Oscar Piastri on Avoiding George Russell’s Stopped Car in São Paulo GP: ‘Scary’
item.description: Oscar Piastri called it “scary” after he and Isack Hadjar had to avoid George Russell’s spun Mercedes at the pit exit in the F1 São Paulo GP. The changing conditions caught out Mercedes’ Russell in the F1 São Paulo GP. After the pit stop, while on his way out of the pits, the Brit spun by himself , running over the curbs. He had switched to the slick compound on the greasy circuit. It was a scary moment, since several cars were leaving the pits at the same time. Red Bull’s Hadjar was directly behind him and had to avoid him quickly. Racing Bulls’ Liam Lawson was next, followed by McLaren’s Piastri. Nem eu acredito que fiz essa foto https://t.co/MxtQa0I09Q — Sam Pancher (@SamPancher) November 8, 2026 Piastri Says Russell Was Stuck in the Middle of the Road It was scary for Piastri . “Scary. Obviously, he was stuck in the middle of the road, so it didn’t make things easy at all, but yeah, glad I could avoid it,” he said to the media. The Australian finished sixth after another difficult race, while teammate Lando Norris won. Russell, meanwhile, lost ground. However, the changing conditions helped him gain places by the end of the F1 Grand Prix, and he eventually finished fourth ahead of teammate Andrea Kimi Antonelli. Russell Admits He Went for a Risky Move Image Credit: Rudy Carezzevoli/Getty Images Russell admitted he had taken a risk and paid the price. “I’m not really too sure what happened, but I went quite high risk because I smelled an opportunity and paid the price,” he said to the media. “It’s in those moments where you either gain a lot, or you lose a lot. This time it went against us. Ironically, because of that, I didn’t pit, and kind of brought myself back into the race. “But we showed really strong pace on the soft. I’d say on the soft tire we had the fastest race pace, and it’s been quite a while since I’ve had the fastest race pace, so I would take the positives of that,” said Russell. His fourth place and Antonelli’s fifth helped Mercedes secure the 2026 F1 constructors’ championship .

item.title: College Sports Commission: NIL Go cleared more than $190 million in deals across September, October 2026
item.description: Across September and October, NIL Go cleared more than $190 million worth of NIL deals, the College Sports Commission announced Monday morning. That’s the second-highest total for a two-month period since NIL Go’s launch last year. Between Sept. 1 and Oct. 31, a total of 10,092 NIL deal were cleared by the system with an aggregate value of $192.62 million, according to the CSC. On the other side, 581 deals worth $20.21 million were not cleared. Additionally, as of Oct. 31, the College Sports Commission said there are not any deals in arbitration. $39.99 gets you a FULL year of On3 | Rivals national coverage Of the deals cleared over the last two months, 6,599 of them were with associated entities, worth a total value of $140.53 million. The other 3,493 deals were with non-associated entities with a value of $52.09 million – the highest total value for non-associated deals during the 2026 calendar year. The CSC said it took action on 175 NIL deals per day during September and October, and 48% of those deals had resolutions within a week of filling out all required fields. There has also been an increase in “complexity” of submitted deals, which includes clarity about the funding source of deals and money from schools used to fund a third-party “sponsor” that, otherwise, is not seeking a profit. SUBSCRIBE to the On3 NIL and Sports Business Newsletter All told, since NIL Go launched in June 2025, the system has cleared 56,570 deals worth $775.11 million while 2,877 submitted deals, totaling $177.14 million, have not been cleared. The largest totals came between July and August 2026 as the 2026-27 school year approached. Late last month, the College Sports Commission also released data for how much college athletes earn from third-party NIL deals and revenue-sharing. For college football, that data was available by position, with the highest-paid Power Four quarterbacks earning around $1.6 million, excluding those who made $0. The data also includes the amount of money distributed from schools to athletes through revenue-sharing as part of the House settlement. From June 2025 through June 2026, schools paid out $1.77 billion in rev-share payments through the CAPS system. For third-party NIL, quarterbacks at the P4 level earn a median $65,500, and that figure goes up to $996,049 in the 90th percentile. For non-P4 quarterbacks, those numbers are $1,570 and $21,805, respectively. “This is the first time compensation data of this kind has been published for college sports,” College Sports Commission CEO Bryan Seeley said in a statement. “The CSC is making this aggregated, anonymized information available to student-athletes, schools, and the public to help people make better informed decisions while preserving the confidentiality of individual agreements.”

item.title: Wimborne to host Bradford in FA Cup second round
item.description: Seventh-tier side Wimborne Town will host League One Bradford City in the second round of the FA Cup. The Magpies shocked Crawley Town on Sunday in the first round, scoring twice to dump their League Two opponents out of the competition and progress to the second round for the first time. The Bantams thumped Marine 7-0 on Saturday and sit seventh in the third tier. Elsewhere in the draw, former Premier League and FA Cup winners Leicester City will travel to National League South side Dover Athletic. Fresh from beating Sholing 6-0 , Salisbury FC of the sixth tier will face League One Blackpool at the Ray Mac Stadium. National League side AFC Fylde will host Jack Wilshere's Luton Town and seventh-tier Guiseley AFC will take on Notts County of League One. The second round will take place on the weekend starting Friday, 4 December. Second-round winners will receive £79,500 in prize money, with £21,200 for the losing clubs. item.title: Patriots trade deadline tracker: News and rumors ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline
item.description: Even though they have already matched their total losses from last year, the New England Patriots once again look like a legitimate contender for a playoff spot in the AFC. However, in order to get there, they will have to find a way to overcome the injuries that have ravaged their roster over the first two months of the regular season. While the expectation is that they will get several players back from injured reserve at some point, they also could go for a more radical approach in hopes of improving their team and gearing up for a stretch run in 2026. Like they have done multiple times in 2026 already, they could look at the trade market. Will there be additions to a list that already includes the likes of A.J. Brown, Jaylen Reed, Corey Kiner and Walter Rouse? Or could they move on from some of their players, like they did in 2025 ? We will know soon: the NFL trade deadline is coming up on Tuesday, November 10, at 4 p.m. ET. Until then, please make sure to bookmark and regularly revisit our Patriots trade deadline tracker for all the latest developments. Patriots trades TBD Patriots trade rumors 2026 Latest rumors at the top. Regardless of Christian Barmore’s outlook, the Patriots “want another pass rusher” to complement their current edge group. At the moment, the team has Dre’Mont Jones, Elijah Ponder and Gabe Jacas as its three-player rotation at the position. | Report The Patriots are “lurking” in the wide receiver trade market ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline. They currently have four wide receivers on their active roster, but with A.J. Brown nursing a knee injury could benefit from more depth. Some of it will come in the form of Mack Hollins, with Romeo Doubs expected to return from IR after the Week 11 bye. | Report The Patriots are not actively shopping Christian Barmore or Carlton Davis. That does not mean they won’t listen to offers, but they have not put up the “for sale” signs just yet. | Report The Patriots are conducting “business as normal” with less than a week to go until the NFL trade deadline. | Report The Patriots are looking to buy at the trade deadline, with edge help a particular focus. | Report The Patriots are reportedly looking for a fourth-round draft pick in a potential Christian Barmore trade. | Report Cornerback Carlton Davis is speculated as another trade candidate. | Report Patriots defensive tackle Christian Barmore reportedly “could be had” via trade. | Report Wide receiver Josh Down has requested a trade from the Colts. | Report “Wide receiver-needy teams” have reportedly called the Colts about fourth-year man Josh Downs. Downs, of course, is a former college teammate of Patriots quarterback Drake Maye. | Report Quenton Nelson will not be coming to New England. The Colts, who recently fired general manager Chris Ballard and are in full fire-sale mode, have decided to trade the All-Pro guard to Seattle. The Seahawks invested a 2027 third-round draft pick and 2028 fifth-rounder in Nelson. | Report

item.title: Lions Owner Gives Jack Campbell Update After Teammates Sweetly Honor Him Following Scary Neck Injury
item.description: Jack Campbell Credit: Michael Owens/Getty NEED TO KNOW Detroit Lions owner Sheila Ford Hamp provided an update on injured linebacker Jack Campbell following the team’s 19-9 win on Sunday over the Miami Dolphins “I know he’s as proud of you as I am,” the Lions’ owner told the team following its emotional win Campbell provided an update via the team last week, telling fans he was “incredibly encouraged” by his recovery amid concerns about his future mobility Detroit Lions owner Sheila Ford Hamp provided an update on Jack Campbell following the team’s win on Sunday, Nov. 8, as the linebacker continues to recover in the hospital after a serious neck injury. “I just wanted to say how incredibly proud I am of everyone in this room, all you players and the coaches,” Hamp, 74, told the Lions locker room following the team’s 19-9 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday. “This has been a hugely emotional week. You all hung together, stuck together, leaned on each other, and look what we did: We won. It was great. I’m so proud of you all.” The update comes one week after Campbell, 26, was stretchered off the field and taken to the hospital after he sustained the neck injury while tackling Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson in the second half of the Lions’ 19-15 victory on Nov. 1. “I saw Jack a couple days ago, and he was worried about all of you,” Hamp said. “Well, I know he’s not now. I know he’s as proud of you as I am. So, awesome job and congratulations. We’re all proud of you and with you.” Lions players honored Campbell by awarding him the game ball following Sunday’s win. They also held up his jersey in the locker room. Game ball's going to freakin' Jack Campbell pic.twitter.com/VGHOBpWrww — Detroit Lions (@Lions) November 9, 2026 The Lions shared a video of the team’s emotional postgame celebration Sunday, when head coach Dan Campbell told his players he was “so proud” of them — not only as a team, but as people — for how they played despite the circumstances surrounding their teammates’ health. “As the person, man, and your freaking teammate, I’m so proud of you guys,” Coach Campbell said. “I am unbelievably proud of the week that we had to be able to come in here and finish the way that we finished against a hungry, young team. I’m very proud of you. I really am, man.” The Lions coach continued: “I love this team. It was built for a reason. The guys that are in this room, you’re in here for a reason. And of course, football players. But it’s what you freaking made of, man, it’s important.” Dan Campbell added, “Okay, listen. Game ball’s going to freakin’ Jack Campbell!” prompting the players to erupt in cheers. One Lions player could be heard calling out, “Yes, sir!” as the team clapped for the tribute. item.title: Paul George vs. Jaylen Brown Stats Comparison: How Celtics, 76ers Stars Have Performed Since Trade
item.description: Paul George vs. Jaylen Brown Stats Comparison: How Celtics, 76ers Stars Have Performed Since Trade originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Over the course of the 2026-27 season, both Celtics and 76ers fans will be interested in seeing how Jaylen Brown and Paul George perform on their new teams. Brown is still in his prime after 10 seasons in Boston, but George is on the back end of his career as he plays in his 17th NBA season. However, it's Brown who is in a more crowded lineup alongside Tyrese Maxey, LeBron James and Joel Embiid, whereas George has more clear-cut opportunities next to Jayson Tatum. So far, both the Celtics and 76ers have to be pleased with how the trade is aging. Brown was instrumental in the 76ers landing LeBron James, and has been as advertised for the 76ers, but George's performance in Boston seems to be better than how he produced in his two seasons in Philadelphia. When the Celtics play the 76ers on Tuesday night, it will mark the first game between the two sides since they executed the Brown-George trade. Besides Brown and Tatum playing as opponents for the first time, a mini-battle will also be whether Brown or George has the better game. With that in mind, here's a look at how Brown and George have performed so far with their new teams. Paul George vs. Jaylen Brown Stats Comparison Paul George Jaylen Brown Games 9 10 MPG 30.1 35.8 PPG 20.4 22.3 RPG 5.2 6.7 APG 4.1 4.0 SPG 2.3 1.2 BPG 0.4 0.4 FG% 46.5% 47.7% 3P% 42.5% 39.2% FT% 80.8% 71.4% Both George and Brown are off to strong starts this year, as they each have over 20 points, five rebounds and four assists per game. Unsurprisingly, Brown's offensive numbers are a touch better, as he is averaging over four more minutes per game. The 76ers star has turned it on lately, averaging 27.3 points with at least five rebounds in each of the last four games. George has also shone with two 25-point performances in his last three, but those sandwiched his lowest point-total game of the season as well. In his young 76ers career, Brown's numbers are pretty much in line with his career averages, even if they are down from his breakout last season. Two years ago, Brown had similar numbers across the board when he was a co-star with Jayson Tatum instead of a definitive No. 1 option. However, George's defensive numbers stick out a bit more, especially since he is averaging 2.3 steals per game so far, which is in the top five in the NBA. Additionally, while Brown has been more efficient overall, George has been better from deep, with a better three-point percentage. George's numbers are also very much a step above what he was producing in Philadelphia. From 2024-26, George averaged just 16.7 points per game with a three-point percentage of 37.5 percent, which was underwhelming considering his big contract. item.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
item.description: Hackers are actively exploiting a recently discovered critical vulnerability that allows them to log in to privileged accounts on many Linux systems, multiple researchers are reporting. The vulnerability, tracked under the name *sshole, arises from the interaction between OpenSSH and a code library known as musl. Linux systems that use both of these packages and meet certain other requirements can be hacked to give unauthenticated access to high-privilege accounts in a matter of seconds. *sshole became publicly known last Thursday and quickly stoked concerns it could lead to widespread compromise of Linux machines. Four days later, the prediction shows signs of becoming real. Attackers conducting "mature intrusions" Security firm Greynoise said Monday that honeypots it maintains in Southeast Asia have come under attack by a group it’s tracking as GT10. The group conducted “mature intrusions" into the systems, which Greynoise uses to detect attempted or successful attacks in real time. Greynoise subsequently gained access to a GT10 server that revealed potential other victims and some of the tools used in the campaign. A backdoor the group is using in the attacks contains Chinese language comments and appears to be generated with the use of AI. Read full article Comments

item.title: Brad Keselowski’s Longtime Spotter Seals New Cup Series Deal After Explosive RFK Exit
item.description: MARTINSVILLE, VA – OCTOBER 28: Brad Keselowski 6 RFK Racing King s Hawaiian Ford on pit road during qualifying for the NASCAR, Motorsport, USA Cup Series Playoff Xfinity 500 on October 28, 2023 at Martinsville Speedway in Martinsville, VA. Photo by Jeff Robinson/Icon Sportswire AUTO: OCT 28 NASCAR Cup Series Playoff Xfinity 500 EDITORIAL USE ONLY Icon231028160500 ©IMAGO/Icon Sportswire Brad Keselowski’s impending departure from RFK Racing has reshaped the outlook for the No. 6 team, but the consequences reach beyond the driver’s seat. As the 2012 Cup champion prepares to find his next home, familiar faces from his corner of the garage are lining up elsewhere. One of the most recognizable voices on his radio is among them, with a new assignment waiting at a team building for a bigger future. T.J. Majors, Keselowski’s spotter since 2022, will join Legacy Motor Club as its spotter in 2027 to work with Josh Berry in the No. 42 Toyota. The pair previously worked together at JR Motorsports in the Xfinity Series. Majors discussed the reunion with Dale Earnhardt Jr. “I’m looking forward to doing that. Me and Josh worked with each other there and had a good relationship there,” Majors told Dale Jr . “And Josh, I’m looking forward to that. They got a lot of good things going on there, a lot of good people learning more about it every day, and I’m excited. They’re building a new shop, which is about eight minutes from the house. So that’s pretty cool. Looking forward to it.” Majors’ move comes as Keselowski’s RFK chapter reaches its final weeks. The team announced September 29 that the 36-time Cup winner would not return as driver of the No. 6 Ford after 2026. Keselowski joined as a co-owner in 2021 and began driving for RFK the following season, helping direct its competitive rebuild effort. A trusted partnership just found new life in NASCAR. Subscribe to stay ahead of every crew chief move and team restructuring that reshapes the Cup Series landscape. The split was not simply a driver change. RFK wanted Keselowski to move more quickly toward leading its competition department, while he wanted to continue racing. Their timelines did not align. Keselowski has made clear he intends to pursue another driving opportunity for 2027. For Majors, the next step brings a familiar driver back into focus. He spotted Berry in the No. 8 JR Motorsports Chevrolet in 2023. That previous relationship gives the pairing a head start, even as Berry prepares for a manufacturer change and a new Cup organization. Berry’s route to Legacy was far from straightforward. Wood Brothers Racing told him in June it would not retain him for 2027, leaving him without a confirmed Cup seat despite winning at Las Vegas in 2025. Through the first 21 races of 2026, he had only two top-10 finishes. Then the No. 21 team found a different gear. We said at the beginning of the game, whatever it takes to come out with a win, and we did that. “It’s good to clean things up with a win,” Prescott said. “The way to get consistent is to get back to work and make sure we’re doing everything right, discipline and details, and make sure we’re playing better.” So what should the Cowboys do from here? Unfortunately for the Cowboys, the amount of time needed was clearly more than a few months. “Chasing an NFC East title just because you don’t think the Giants are for real is an admirable idea, but even if the Cowboys were to catch New York, is this the kind of team that can really expect to make noise in the playoffs? Doubtful.” Related: The 1 trade Cowboys must make in final week before 2026 NFL trade deadline Related: Cowboys’ Brian Schottenheimer is just happy to escape ‘crazy’ Colts game with a win

item.title: “Trouble understanding” – Chelsea not improving under Alonso claims pundit
item.description: “Trouble understanding” – Chelsea not improving under Alonso claims pundit Chelsea are struggling to show they’ve improved much at all since the summer, with another defeat received at the weekend. If you enjoy Talk Chelsea coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. Chelsea were beaten by Sunderland on Sunday, and more worrying in a way than the defeat was the performance. On the London is Blue podcast this week, presenter Nick Verlaney put it very well. Looking at the stats from the game, it’s clear that this was no fluke. Chelsea didn’t create nearly enough. “69% possession. We had one big chance. They had four big chances. We had ten total shots, we made their keeper save the ball four times, but there was only one good save our of those four,” Verlaney pointed out. “It simply did not rise to the level of where we expect this team to be at this point of time in the season. It is November, there have been breaks in the schedule. There’s about to be another break right after this, going into yet another international break on a loss, we did that after Brentford last time.” “I’m having a lot of trouble understanding where we are right now,” he concluded. Chelsea fans puzzled by lack of progress Levi Colwill fouls. (Photo by George Wood/Getty Images) That seems to be the prevailing feeling, ten games into the Xabi Alonso reign. We’re not terrible, but we’re not that good, and most importantly we don’t seem to be getting much better. In other news… Mike Penders has spoken out after Chelsea’s defeat and tried to point to some positives. The midfield was also solid in the game, but they were let down by more soft defending behind them and more blunt attacking ahead of them.

item.title: Eagles most to blame for ugly loss to Giants with trade deadline looming
item.description: Image Credit: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images Eagles most to blame for ugly loss to Giants with trade deadline looming appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Philadelphia Eagles changed quarterbacks, but the offense remained broken. Sunday’s 19-11 loss to the New York Giants extended Philadelphia’s losing streak to seven games, dropped its record to 2-7 and left the organization facing uncomfortable decisions before Tuesday’s trade deadline. Joe Milton ’s first NFL start produced occasional flashes, not a turnaround. Philadelphia struggled to protect him, sustain drives or create enough scoring opportunities to reward a defense that recorded six sacks. The greatest share of the blame belongs to Nick Sirianni and offensive coordinator Sean Mannion , followed by the offensive line. Milton also deserves scrutiny, but making the newcomer the primary scapegoat would ignore the problems surrounding him. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Joe Milton and the receivers missed their opportunities Bill Streicher-Imagn Milton completed 18 of 34 passes for 169 yards without a touchdown or interception. He added 64 rushing yards, showing enough mobility to generate offense when conventional plays stalled. However, his debut also included a false start on Philadelphia’s opening offensive play and a miscommunication with Darius Cooper on an unsuccessful third-down pass. Milton later acknowledged that the protection needed to slide toward Reese on the strip-sack. His receivers offered insufficient support, dropping four passes. Those mistakes were particularly costly for an offense already struggling to assemble productive possessions. Nick Sirianni and Sean Mannion failed to simplify the offense Sirianni owns the overall product, and another quarterback change failed to solve Philadelphia’s recurring offensive dysfunction. The Eagles have now struggled to sustain drives with Jalen Hurts, Tanner McKee and Milton operating the offense. That consistency across different quarterbacks points toward a broader problem with execution, protection and offensive structure rather than one player’s limitations. Mannion’s situational decisions deserve particular criticism. On an important fourth-and-1, Philadelphia aligned Milton in the shotgun and handed the ball to Saquon Barkley on a slow-developing run-pass option. The call invited disruption when the Eagles needed a direct, decisive answer. The second-half stagnation was even more revealing. Philadelphia did not record its first first down after halftime until Milton found Dallas Goedert for 19 yards with just over eight minutes remaining in the fourth quarter. With an inexperienced starter, the staff needed to establish manageable situations and dependable answers against pressure. Instead, the offense repeatedly reached moments requiring Milton to overcome breakdowns rather than operate within a stable plan. The offensive line made a difficult debut worse Seve

item.title: Blackhawks’ Connor Bedard addresses players-only meeting after Hurricanes shellacking
item.description: James Guillory-Imagn Images Blackhawks’ Connor Bedard addresses players-only meeting after Hurricanes shellacking appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The 2026-27 NHL season is quickly getting away from the Chicago Blackhawks , who have lost six games in a row, the most recent a lopsided 9-2 defeat at the hands of the defending Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes on Saturday night. With nine losses in their last 10 games overall, Chicago is 4-13-1 and dead last in the Central Division. They’re also 31st league-wide, ahead of only the Vancouver Canucks. The team held a players-only meeting in Raleigh on Saturday, which captain Connor Bedard addressed afterward. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “Just kind of giving ourselves a chance to get some frustration out,” Bedard told reporters, per NHL.com. “There’s a lot of belief and a lot of love for each other. (It’s) a very tight-knit group. It’s been a tough start. Obviously it’s not what we expected. Every guy knows that we’ve got a little more.” No. 98 continued: “There’s frustration. When you’re waking up and going to bed, you’re thinking about the record. I think what we’ve been able to do really well is every practice, every pregame skate, every lunch, dinner, every time we hang out, we still have that camaraderie and that joy to be at the rink. But at the end of the day, we’ve got to be better.” Although there have been rumblings that Chicago was considering a coaching change, multiple reports, including one from The Athletic’s Scott Powers, indicated that the team is not considering replacing head coach Jeff Blashill at this point. “It’s a hard pill to swallow. At the end of the day we got our butts kicked,” Blashill said of the latest loss. “We’ve got to make this kind of a bottom point in the year. We have to find a way to claw our way out of this.” The Blackhawks haven’t advanced to the Stanley Cup Playoffs since 2019-20 and look closer to landing a high lottery pick than earning a postseason berth this year. “It’s not rocket science. It’s not good enough,” Bedard added. “We know that. We’ve got a few days of practice to get better. Try to just wipe this and start 0-0 and start winning some games. There’s belief in the room. There’s belief in everyone from players, coaches, management. We believe in what everyone is trying to do.” Following Saturday’s loss, the Blackhawks are off until Thursday, when they begin a four-game homestand against the Buffalo Sabres at United Center.

item.title: Celtic Chase Ivorian Teenage Destroyer: Should They Overpay To Win The Race?
item.description: Celtic Chase Ivorian Teenage Destroyer: Should They Overpay To Win The Race? Martin O’Neill has watched the 2026/27 season unravel at Parkhead, and Celtic’s seven domestic and European defeats tell only part of the story. The 2-0 loss at Falkirk hurt most, leaving the manager under pressure before the Hoops edged Beşiktaş 3-2 in the Europa League. That win, their first in the Europa League after three straight defeats, keeps their continental hopes alive for now, but it papered over a problem that keeps resurfacing. The weakness sits directly in front of the back four. The defensive midfield unit looks fragile, and physical opponents have exposed it repeatedly in transition. Captain Callum McGregor still anchors the pivot, yet he cannot cover every yard alone. Luke McCowan, contracted until 2028, has been frozen out after disastrous tactical displays in European qualifying, which leaves O’Neill short of dependable cover. Arne Engels’s high-profile summer departure made matters worse. The club never found a high-calibre direct replacement, partly because board-level disagreements stalled a £13 million pursuit of Torino’s Gvidas Gineitis. Nobody has filled that gap since, and the squad still lacks a high-energy profile able to screen the backline, so an athletic defensive midfielder is now O’Neill’s absolute priority for January. Parkhead scouts have found a candidate in Sweden. A Swedish target for Celtic Pete O’Rourke reports in Football Insider that the Scottish champions have turned their attention to BK Hacken’s Abdoulaye Doumbia. The 19-year-old, born in Ivory Coast, has impressed those scouts with his defensive midfield performances, scoring two goals and adding three assists in 25 league appearances for fourth-placed Hacken. He wins the ball in the mid-block, covers plenty of ground sideways, tackles often and passes with range from deep. That profile suits O’Neill’s direct transitional system, which needs a physically imposing screen to disrupt central counter-attacks and release vertical runners. Doumbia brings youthful dynamism, press resistance and tactical discipline, although his age demands patience. Competition is fierce. Everton , Sunderland , Coventry City and other European clubs are interested. Torino’s Gineitis remains an alternative should his asking price fall. Should Celtic overpay to win the race for Doumbia? GLASGOW, SCOTLAND – NOVEMBER 05: Callum McGregor of Celtic applauds the fans after the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD4 match between Celtic FC and Besiktas JK at Celtic Park on November 05, 2026 in Glasgow, Scotland. (Photo by Zak Mauger/Getty Images) Yes, without hesitation. Europe has punished this squad because the club refused to pay the necessary premium for midfield athleticism after losing key personnel, and a cut-price Gineitis deal would repeat that mistake. item.title: 2027: NDC will provide all-inclusive government – Kwankwaso
item.description: By Henry Umoru Ahead of January 16 2027 election, the Vice Presidential Candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso has promised Nigerians that an NDC-led Federal Government under Peter Obi and himself will operate an all-inclusive government. According to him, the Obi-led government would prioritise the interests of every Nigerian, irrespective of political, ethnic, religious or social affiliations. The former Kano State Governor spoke while addressing party leaders, stakeholders and supporters during a carnival-like reception organised in his honour at Toru-Orua, the country home of Senator Henry Seriake Dickson, National Leader of the NDC and the party’s Senatorial candidate for Bayelsa West. In a statement signed by the Coordinator, Ofurumapepe Media of the NDC Campaign Council, Gabriel Ukuta, he explained that Kwankwaso said that what Nigeria needed at this moment in the nation’s political history is a government that would deliberately carry its citizens along in the formulation, implementation of policies and programmes. He said that governance must be people-oriented and responsive to the needs and aspirations of the population. Kwankwaso said the NDC has positioned itself as a credible alternative political platform with the capacity, leadership and commitment to deliver the inclusive governance Nigerians desire. The NDC Vice Presidential Candidate said, “Nigerians deserve a government that will listen to them, accommodate their interests and ensure that no section of the country is left behind. An NDC-led Federal Government will be an all-inclusive government that will carry everybody along in its policies and programmes,” Kwankwaso who condemned what he described as the prevailing hunger, economic hardship and insecurity under the All Progressives Congress (APC)-led Federal Government, urged Nigerians to take advantage of the 2027 general elections to vote out the ruling party. The Vice Presidential Candidate who called on citizens to take collective responsibility for the electoral process by coming out en masse to vote for the NDC and ensuring that their votes count, expressed concern over alleged attempts by anti-democracy forces and agents of the ruling party to manipulate the outcome of the forthcoming elections, insisting that Nigerians must remain vigilant and protect their votes. “Voting is not enough; Nigerians must also take responsibility for protecting their votes. We must all work together to ensure that the wishes of the people are respected and that the outcome of the elections reflects the collective decision of the electorate,” he added. He expressed appreciation to Senator Dickson, members of the NDC National Working Committee (NWC), the National Campaign Council (NCC), party stakeholders, candidates and supporters across Bayelsa State for the impressive reception accorded him. item.title: La NASA busca a la próxima generación de astronautas
item.description: La NASA anunció su promoción de candidatos a astronautas de 2025 el 22 de septiembre de 2025 en el Centro Espacial Johnson de la agencia, en Houston. Crédito: NASA/Helen Arase Vargas Read this release in English here . La NASA busca a los exploradores que ayudarán a escribir el próximo capítulo de los vuelos espaciales tripulados. Ya está abierto el plazo de inscripción para la próxima promoción de astronautas de la agencia, que se incorporarán a la NASA en un momento en el que Estados Unidos regresa a la Luna, construye la Base Lunar y sienta las bases para las primeras misiones tripuladas a Marte. La próxima generación de astronautas se entrenará para operar en la superficie lunar, vivir y trabajar fuera de la Tierra, y llevar a cabo misiones que ampliarán los límites de la exploración con seres humanos más lejos que nunca. Los ciudadanos estadounidenses interesados en formar parte del cuerpo de astronautas tienen hasta las 11:59 p.m. EST (hora del este) del jueves 3 de diciembre para enviar la documentación completa de su solicitud a: https://go.nasa.gov/3WyvlQi “Este es un momento extraordinario para incorporarse al cuerpo de astronautas de la NASA”, afirmó el administrador de la agencia espacial, Jared Isaacman. “Las personas que seleccionemos podrían pisar la Luna, vivir y trabajar en la Base Lunar, y ayudar a desarrollar los sistemas y operaciones que, en última instancia, llevarán a las tripulaciones a Marte. Esas misiones exigirán excelencia técnica, buen criterio, trabajo en equipo y valentía. El cuerpo de astronautas de la NASA siempre ha recurrido a estadounidenses excepcionales con la disposición de asumir retos extraordinarios al servicio de la nación. Si quieres unirte a esa tradición, ven a ayudarnos a escribir el próximo capítulo de la mayor aventura de la humanidad”. La NASA prevé realizar su selección definitiva a finales de 2027 para comenzar la capacitación de la próxima promoción de candidatos a astronautas. “La ventana de oportunidad está abierta. La misión nos espera. Y lo único que falta en la mayor aventura en la que se ha embarcado la humanidad eres tú”, afirmó Matt Anderson, administrador adjunto de la NASA. La agencia abrió por última vez la convocatoria en 2024. De entre más de 8.000 candidaturas, en 2025 se seleccionaron 10 candidatos a astronautas, que actualmente están completando casi dos años de capacitación. “Para quienes presentan su candidatura, convertirse en astronauta de la NASA es más que una oportunidad profesional”, afirmó Scott Tingle, astronauta jefe y presidente de la Junta de Selección de Astronautas del Centro Espacial Johnson de la NASA, en Houston. “Es una oportunidad para formar parte de un legado de exploradores que han ampliado los límites del conocimiento y desempeñar un papel en las misiones que marcarán el futuro de la humanidad en el espacio. item.title: UK man convicted of fraud for secretly working five government jobs at once
item.description: A 56-year-old civil servant in the United Kingdom, UK, Kashim Chowdhury has been convicted of nine counts of fraud after secretly holding multiple full-time government jobs and fraudulently earning more than £284,000 in taxpayers’ money. Chowdhury, from east London, held five overlapping government positions in the spring of 2023, concealing his multiple employment arrangements from the departments that hired him. After seven hours of deliberation, a jury unanimously found him guilty of eight counts of fraud by false representation and one count of fraud by failure to disclose. The prosecution accused Chowdhury of “deliberate, intentional dishonesty” and “exploiting the system” to secure multiple salaries from public sector employers. During the proceedings, the judge said Chowdhury faced a “very significant custodial sentence”. He also refused him bail, citing the seriousness of the offences and Chowdhury’s own wellbeing. Sarah Melo, a specialist prosecutor at the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) Serious Economic Organised Crime and International Directorate, described his actions as sustained dishonesty. “This was sustained and deliberate dishonesty,” Melo said. “He knew he could not legitimately hold multiple full-time positions at the same time, but continued to conceal what he was doing.” A spokesperson for the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra) said Chowdhury had “abused the trust placed in him as a public servant”. The department added that it would use all available avenues to recover the proceeds of his offending. Between 2020 and 2023, Chowdhury held eight overlapping full-time public sector positions and earned a total of £350,000, according to evidence presented in court. Prosecutors told the court that he provided inaccurate information about his employment status on job application forms and failed to disclose to government departments that he was already employed as a civil servant. After securing the positions, he also failed to inform his employers that he was working for other government departments. Chowdhury was permitted to work entirely from home after telling his employers he was caring for his mother, with whom he lived in east London. His mother had dementia and was diagnosed with terminal cancer in 2023. However, rather than reduce his workload to care for her, he continued taking on additional government positions. In the spring of 2023, he held positions across the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, the Department of Health and Social Care, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA), the Department for Business and Trade, the Food Standards Agency and the Home Office. During the period, he was contracted to work 183 hours a week, exceeding the total number of hours available in seven days. item.title: Pentagon mulls placing fleet of military satellites around the Moon
item.description: The US military has published a Request for Information on a federal procurement website signaling interest in deploying a "proliferated cislunar constellation" consisting of an unspecified number of satellites performing an undisclosed mission in the vicinity of the Moon. The announcement follows statements in recent months from the Space Force's acquisitions chief for advanced programs, Maj. Gen. Stephen Purdy, that the military was getting serious about extending its reach to the Moon. The Space Force's most distant satellites today are in geostationary orbit, some 22,000 miles (36,000 kilometers) over the equator, collecting routine surveillance and missile warning data. Most recently, Purdy spoke of a shift in Pentagon leadership's thinking about the Moon following an executive order signed by President Donald Trump last December. The order set out the Trump administration's space policy. One section of the order deals with the US government's ability to detect, characterize, and counter threats to US space interests from low-Earth orbit to cislunar space, the term of art for the region of space around the Moon. item.title: Full list: Canada lists foreigners eligible for rural permanent residence
item.description: Canada has outlined six eligibility requirements for foreign nationals seeking permanent residence through its Rural Community Immigration Program, a pathway designed to attract skilled immigrants to participating rural communities across the country. The programme offers permanent residence to eligible foreigners who want to work and settle in selected Canadian communities, particularly areas seeking skilled migrants to fill positions that cannot be filled by local residents. According to Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), participating communities will approve designated employers to recruit skilled foreign nationals for available positions. To qualify for permanent residence under the programme, applicants must obtain a valid recommendation certificate from a participating community and secure a valid job offer from a designated employer within that community. They must also have at least one year, equivalent to 1,560 hours, of related work experience within the previous three years. Other requirements include demonstrating language proficiency through an approved test, possessing a Canadian educational credential or its foreign equivalent, and providing proof of sufficient funds to support themselves and their families. Full list of eligibility requirements According to IRCC, foreigners seeking permanent residence through the programme must meet the following six requirements: Community recommendation: Obtain a valid recommendation certificate from a participating community in Canada. Valid job offer: Secure a valid job offer from a designated employer within the participating community. Work experience: Have at least one year (1,560 hours) of related work experience within the past three years. Language proficiency: Demonstrate English or French language ability by taking an approved language test. Educational qualification: Possess a Canadian educational credential or a foreign equivalent. Proof of funds: Provide evidence of having sufficient money to support themselves and their families after arriving in Canada. The programme is designed to help participating rural communities attract skilled foreign nationals while providing immigrants with an opportunity to obtain permanent residence and establish themselves in Canada. Applicants are required to satisfy the eligibility conditions and secure the necessary community recommendation and employment offer before applying for permanent residence. item.title: NYT bestseller ‘Robopocalypse’ is getting a TV series with Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman at the helm
item.description: null They say all good things come to those who wait… and WAIT. Well, the wait for "Robopocalypse" fans might finally be over, as Oscar winners Ron Howard and Akiva Goldsman have announced they're working on a TV adaptation. It does seem like an eternity since news first broke that Portland-based New York Times bestselling author Daniel H. Wilson’s "Robopocalypse" (Doubleday, 2011) was bought by Steven Spielberg’s DreamWorks SKG for a sci-fi spectacle, with Drew Goddard ("The Martian") brought in to pen the screenplay. That was back in 2009, and since then the story of a rogue AI named Archos and a hearty band of indigenous people in America’s heartland battling to save humanity from extinction has been placed on Hollywood’s back burner. After numerous stalled starts and director Michael Bay getting involved in 2018, "Robopocalypse" was quietly powered down due to script issues, filmmaker scheduling conflicts, and the enormous budget required. But now we have been blessed with the news , first broken by The Hollywood Reporter, that Ron Howard ("Apollo 13," "The Da Vinci Code") and Akiva Goldsman ("A Beautiful Mind," "Star Trek: Strange New Worlds") have taken up the mantle of this chilling sci-fi project to develop as a new TV series. And what timing, just as AI fever has gripped the planet with paranoia centered around our eventual robot overlords. "'Robopocalypse' has all the scale and suspense of a major action story, but what drew me to it are the thought-provoking themes and humanity at its center," Ron Howard shared in a statement. The cover of 2011's smash sci-fi hit Robopocalypse by Daniel H. Wilson Vintage The cover of the 2014 sequel Robogenesis by Daniel H. Wilson Vintage "Daniel created a future that feels both startling and increasingly plausible, with characters who must figure out what connects us when the technology we rely on turns against us. I am also thrilled to work with Akiva again. We have shared some incredibly meaningful creative experiences, and this feels like the right story to bring us back together." As a PhD graduate of Carnegie Mellon University’s Robotics Institute and a future king of the techno-thriller, Wilson was the ideal writer to bring this frightening story to life, and a 2014 sequel titled "Robogenesis" was equally gripping. The prolific, award-winning writer has since set up a multitude of other Hollywood projects spawned from his catalog of works, including "Amped," "The Clockwork Dynasty," the authorized sequel to Michael Crichton's "The Andromeda Strain," " The Andromeda Evolution ," and his 2025 alien invasion novel "Hole in the Sky," still alive at Netflix. Daniel H. Wilson's "Robopocalypse" is headed for the small screen! (Image credit: Daniel H. Wilson) Howard's Imagine Entertainment will partner with Akiva Goldsman's Weed Road Pictures on this episodic adaptation, with Howard attached to direct the pilot episode and Goldsman serving as series showrunner.
